RAMESH  SOMASUNDARAM  
9943993925| rameshsundaram@rediffmail.com 
 
CAREER SUMMARY 
 
Investment Operations professional with 20+ years of experience across fund accounting, capital markets operations, 
and asset servicing within global financial institutions. Strong expertise in fund accounting, NAV validation and oversight, 
reconciliation and multi asset class processing including equities, derivatives, fixed income and OTC. 
 
Proven leadership experience in managing large teams, ensuring SLA adherence, and delivering accurate and timely NAV 
through robust control frameworks and exception management. 
 
Demonstrated ability in stakeholder management, break resolution, audit compliance and process transformation with 
continuous improvement within complex investment banking environments. 
 
• Ability to demonstrate the issues and deal with real life scenarios 
• Strong analysis skills to identify the risks and in turn identify the preventive measurements 
• Believe in process, quality initiatives and transformation initiatives for efficiency gains 
• Excellent team player and flexible to adapt to new environments

Investment Operations Certificate | CISI 2018 
(Global Securities Operations,

WORK EXPERIENCE – INVESTMENT OPERATIONS

Operations & Domain Leadership

processing, pricing, income accruals, and portfolio valuation across multiple asset classes

final NAV release

coordination

collateral management, and portfolio valuation

distributions ensuring accurate accounting impact

Controls, Risk & Audit

reporting 
• Acted as Audit SPOC (M&T controls) ensuring compliance with internal and external audit requirements 
• Conducted root cause analysis on operational issues and implemented corrective/preventive actions 
• Ensured all processes are aligned with regulatory and risk management standards 
 
Leadership & People Management

benchmarks 
• Conducted performance reviews, coaching, and development planning 
• Managed workforce planning, shift allocation, and capacity management to support business continuity 
• Acted as escalation point for operational issues and stakeholder queries 
 
Stakeholder & Client Management 
 
• Collaborated with global clients, custodians, and internal stakeholders to resolve complex operational issues 
• Prepared and presented MIS reports (weekly/monthly) covering SLA performance, risk metrics, and operational 
updates 
• Built strong client relationships through effective communication and issue resolution 
 
Change Management & Process Improvement 
 
• Supported process transitions, system enhancements, and client onboarding initiatives 
• Led initiatives to improve operational efficiency, reduce errors, and enhance turnaround times 
• Maintained SOPs, SLAs, and process documentation aligned with governance standards
